title: wiretap: Fix our Sysdig event size calculations
description:
Add an event data length element to the wtap_syscall_header. Use it
where we need to supply the size of our data.

Note that we might want to include the event header along with the data
in our packet / event buffer.

Remove some debugging code.

Fixes #20462
